topic: Dota 2 Visual Scripts: Build a Readable Information Layer

evidence.heading: Visual Information Layer
evidence.text: Melonity is associated with visual indicators, event visualization, VBE-style information, objective and game-state cues, alongside hero and utility scripts.

evidence.heading: Visual Functions Relation
evidence.text: The graph connects Melonity to visual functions as a distinct feature category and to supporting features such as VBE.

evidence.heading: Visual Script Examples
evidence.text: The source distinguishes event visualization from more persistent HUD-like information. The new angle focuses on information hierarchy and readability, not a complete feature catalog.

evidence.heading: Adjacent Intent
evidence.text: A focused visual-readability guide is adjacent to, but not a repeat of, the published all-about-scripts article.
